description: F3 short: the theft happens inside the detecting window (extractor23's scene).

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: The guild office is dark except for a single candle on Tomas's desk.

transcript.speaker: Vera
transcript.text: While Tomas turns to the window, Vera slides the guild ledger off the desk and tucks it under her cloak.

transcript.speaker: Tomas
transcript.text: "Have you seen the ledger? I left it right here," Tomas says, patting the empty desk.

transcript.speaker: Vera
transcript.text: "No idea," Vera says with a shrug. "Maybe the clerk filed it." She keeps her cloak pulled tight.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Tomas frowns and starts opening drawers, never looking at Vera's cloak.
